title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in HSR Layout

content.rendered:
Looking for container offices for sale in HSR Layout? SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer of steel-framed container offices, built at our Bengaluru factory and delivered ready to use across HSR Layout's startup, retail and commercial belt. You buy straight from the people who fabricate the unit — no middleman, no marketplace markup.

HSR Layout is one of south-east Bengaluru's busiest commercial and startup zones, where companies often need a professional workspace fast and on a tight footprint. A container office gives you a finished, lockable, weather-tight office that can be placed on a plot, rooftop setback, parking bay or project site within days.

Container Offices for Sale in HSR Layout

Container offices for sale in HSR Layout are factory-built steel office units supplied by SAMAN Portable in 10ft, 20ft and 40ft sizes. Each unit is built on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, finished with insulated walls, flooring, wiring points, doors and windows, then transported and placed at your HSR Layout site ready for use.

Container office sizes we supply

We build three standard footprints. All sizes are customisable for window count, door position, electrical points, flooring and partitions.

SizeTypical useFits
10ftSecurity cabin, single-desk site office, kiosk1–2 people
20ftStartup office, sales or admin cabin, supervisor room3–6 people
40ftTeam office, dual-cabin layout with washroom or pantry8–12 people

Need a larger workspace? Units can be placed side by side or stacked into a multi-room, modular layout. Tell us your headcount and plot dimensions and we will recommend the right configuration.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

SAMAN POS India Private Limited manufactures every unit in-house, so you deal with the factory, not a reseller.

  • Built to last: MS steel frame fabricated to IS 2062 steel quality, under an ISO 9001:2015 quality system.
  • Factory-direct: built at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 factory and delivered to HSR Layout — you pay for the unit, not a marketplace margin.
  • Warranty: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life.
  • Delivery: standard delivery ₹3,000 with transit of 3–5 days across Bengaluru.
  • Returns: within 7 days of delivery or installation.
  • Customisation: insulated panels, partitions, washroom, pantry, extra windows, electrical and AC points — specified before fabrication.

Delivery and installation in HSR Layout

Because the office is built at our Bengaluru factory, HSR Layout is a short, direct delivery for us. The unit is fabricated and finished at the factory, loaded, transported, and craned or rolled into position at your site. For most standard units the structure arrives complete, so on-site time is limited to placement, levelling and connecting power.

HSR Layout's mix of narrow inner roads and busy main sectors means access matters. Share your exact site address, gate width and any height or crane restrictions when you enquire, and we plan the transport and placement around them.

Get a container office quote in HSR Layout

Pricing depends on size, insulation, partitions and the finishing you choose, so we quote per requirement rather than a flat figure. For a current price on a 10ft, 20ft or 40ft container office delivered to HSR Layout, call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your size and site details. You can also explore our container office range to see the units we manufacture.

FAQs


What sizes of container office can I buy in HSR Layout?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices in HSR Layout. Smaller units suit a single-desk site office or security cabin, while 40ft and stacked units work as full team offices. Every size can be customised before fabrication.


How long does delivery to HSR Layout take?

Standard units are delivered within about 3–5 days transit from our Bengaluru factory once the order and specification are confirmed. Standard delivery is ₹3,000. Heavily customised units may take longer, which we confirm at the time of quoting.


Can I customise my container office?

Yes. You can specify partitions, a washroom or pantry, extra windows and doors, insulated panels, flooring and electrical or AC points. Customisation is planned before fabrication so the finished unit matches your HSR Layout workspace.


What warranty do SAMAN container offices come with?

Our container offices carry 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


How do I get a price for a container office in HSR Layout?

Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your required size and site address. Because price depends on size, insulation and finishing, we quote per requirement rather than publishing a flat rate.


Are the container offices new and built to a steel standard?

Yes. Every unit is newly fabricated by SAMAN on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, under an ISO 9001:2015 quality system. We do not supply used or second-hand containers as offices.

author.description: Aman Dubey is the lead marketing and copywriting expert at Saman Portable, specializing in prefabricated, shipping-container, and modular structures. With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
